prompt.project_info: Create photorealistic unstylized lifestyle photography in a tropical garden with strong natural texture and color.
prompt.main_subject: An adult woman with tanned skin, long wavy blonde hair, and a natural feminine silhouette wearing a bright pink string bikini and shell choker. She has a confident neutral expression with a slight pout and a direct gaze.
prompt.composition_elements: Medium-full centered eye-level frame. The subject leans back against a tree with her right hand raised on the trunk and left arm down. Surround her with tropical tree trunks, large green leaves, a stone path, and strong dappled shadows.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Direct bright sunlight with glossy natural highlights and high contrast across vibrant hot pink and green tones.
prompt.technical_specs: 3:4 portrait, sharp focus, visible skin texture and specular reflections, photorealistic unstylized lifestyle photography, preserve pose alignment, limb placement, foreground depth, and subject-background separation.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Photorealistic unstylized lifestyle photograph of an adult woman with tanned skin and long wavy blonde hair, wearing a bright pink string bikini and shell choker. She leans back against a tree, right hand raised resting on the trunk, left arm down, with a relaxed confident stance and direct gaze. Set her in an outdoor tropical garden with tree trunks, large green leaves, and a stone path. Medium-full shot, eye-level, centered framing, direct bright sunlight, strong dappled shadows, glossy natural skin highlights, vibrant warm tones, high contrast, sharp visible texture, 3:4 aspect ratio. Preserve shoulder alignment, hip alignment, limb placement, foreground depth, and subject-background separation.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, nudity, sexualized pose, fetish framing, minor, celebrity likeness, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, stylization, distortion, proportion changes, depth flattening, beautification filters, blurry, bad anatomy, extra fingers, deformed, watermark
